name: be-corporate-tax
description: Belgian corporate income tax (vennootschapsbelasting / impôt des sociétés) for income year 2026 (assessment year 2027): companies resident in Belgium and Belgian permanent establishments of foreign companies (belasting niet-inwoners). Covers the 25% rate and the 20% small-company rate on the first EUR 100,000 with the 2026 director pay test (EUR 51,000), the 20% cap on flat-rate benefits in kind, the taxable base, the dividends received deduction, the capital gains exemption on shares, the 70% basket rule above EUR 1m, loss carry-forward, the group contribution, the interest limit, advance payments and the 6.75% increase, Biztax filing, penalties, 30% withholding and the parent-subsidiary exemption. Trigger on: vennootschapsbelasting, VenB, impôt des sociétés, ISoc, verlaagd tarief, bedrijfsleidersbezoldiging, DBI, RDT, korf, groepsbijdrage, voorafbetalingen, Biztax, roerende voorheffing. Out of scope: be-income-tax, be-capital-gains, belgium-payroll, be-vat-return, belgium-financial-s
